mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS errors, COALESCE(AVG(cost), 0) AS avg_rt, COALESCE(SUM(req_bytes), 0) AS req_bytes, COALESCE(SUM(res_bytes), 0) AS res_bytes
COUNT(*) AS `count`, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(cost), 2), 0) AS avg_rt, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 2), 0) AS error_rate
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT app_id) FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '健康'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_gw_api WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND)
SELECT FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND)
SELECT cost FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND) AND cost IS NOT NULL
SELECT cost FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_time >= CURDATE() AND cost IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.service_name, s.app_name, s.ip, s.port, s.status, s.last_heartbeat_time, COALESCE(t.qps, 0) AS qps, COALESCE(t.calls, 0) AS calls, COALESCE(t.avg_cost, 0) AS avg_cost FROM tb_gw_service s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT service_name, SUM(CASE WHEN req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 60 SECOND) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qps, COUNT(*) AS calls, AVG(cost) AS avg_cost FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE req_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowSeconds} SECOND) AND service_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service_name ) t ON t.service_name = s.service_name WHERE s.deleted = 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(t.calls, 0) DESC, COALESCE(t.qps, 0) DESC, CASE WHEN s.status = '健康' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.id DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(req_time) / #{bucketSec}) * #{bucketSec} AS b, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(COALESCE(req_bytes, 0)) AS si, SUM(COALESCE(res_bytes, 0)) AS so FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE GROUP BY b

SELECT t.app_id AS appId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.app_name, ''), t.app_name) AS appName FROM tb_gw_trace_log t JOIN ( SELECT app_id, MAX(id) AS mid FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id != '' GROUP BY app_id ) m ON m.mid = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT app_id, MAX(id) AS sid FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id != '' GROUP BY app_id ) sm ON sm.app_id = t.app_id LEFT JOIN tb_gw_service s ON s.id = sm.sid ORDER BY t.app_id
SELECT DISTINCT service_name FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND service_name IS NOT NULL AND service_name != '' ORDER BY service_name
SELECT DISTINCT api FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND api IS NOT NULL AND api != '' ORDER BY api
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(api, ' ', 1) AS m FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND api LIKE '% %' ORDER BY m
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT app_id) FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT api) FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND api IS NOT NULL
SELECT FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE
SELECT cost FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE AND cost IS NOT NULL
SELECT CAST(status_code AS CHAR) AS name, FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE AND status_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY status_code ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(api, ' ', 1) AS name, FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE AND api LIKE '% %' GROUP BY name ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT t.service_name AS name, MAX(t.app_id) AS app_id, MAX(t.app_name) AS app_name, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.service_name) FROM tb_gw_service s WHERE s.service_id = t.service_name AND s.deleted = 0), t.service_name) AS service_label, COUNT(*) AS `count`, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.cost), 2), 0) AS avg_rt, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 2), 0) AS error_rate FROM tb_gw_trace_log t WHERE AND t.service_name IS NOT NULL AND t.service_name != '' GROUP BY t.service_name ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT t.api AS name, MAX(t.app_id) AS app_id, MAX(t.app_name) AS app_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(s.service_name, t.service_name) SEPARATOR '、') AS service_label, COUNT(*) AS `count`, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.cost), 2), 0) AS avg_rt, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(*), 2), 0) AS error_rate FROM tb_gw_trace_log t LEFT JOIN tb_gw_service s ON s.service_id = t.service_name AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE AND t.api IS NOT NULL AND t.api != '' GROUP BY t.api ORDER BY `count` DESC LIMIT 8
